evidence: Running ./run_repro.sh fails on the first training step. The captured stderr ends in torch._dynamo.utils.tuple_iterator_getitem with IndexError: tuple index out of range while executing LightningModule.toggle_optimizer() from a torch.compile()d model.

Run ./run_repro.sh, which sets PYTHONPATH to codebase/src and executes repro.py.
